body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> International CES 2007, the world''s largest consumer technology tradeshow, will be held from January 8th (local time) to January 11th in Las Vegas, USA. Celebrating its 40th anniversary, CES 2007 will be the venue for hottest product launches from 2,700 exhibitors, covering more than 30 product areas, including the latest in gaming, wireless, digital imaging, mobile electronics, home networking and audio. According to the CEA, organizer of CES 2007, more than 140,000 people will come and see the show.

Especially, this year’s show will host various events and festivities to celebrate its 40th anniversary including its own celebration party at the ESPN/CEA Stage in the Grand Lobby at noon on Monday, January 8, 2007. CES 2007 also prepared several distinguished figures for its keynote speeches such as Bill Gates, chairman and chief software designer of Microsoft Corp, Robert Iger of Walt Disney, John Chambers of Cisco Systems, and more, who will present their views about the mega trends of CE industry. Visitors may also attend 175 conference and Super Sessions to hear from top industry professionals on key technologies and trends

Nine AVING reporters are currently staying in Las Vegas, and they will be there till the end of the show to deliver the news about the latest products and technologies of CES 2007 with vivid photos in real time. Not only the news about world-class companies of Asian counties such as Korea, Taiwan, China, and Japan but also for small- and middle-sized companies will be delivered, which are not relatively known yet in the market but retain prominent products and technologies.
Exclusive coverage of CES 2007 will continue throughout the show in real time from AVING and AVING global news network.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
